verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from several English guidance pages on www.dpma.de (home, trade mark application, patent application and e-filing pages), which implies the public guidance surface serves readable content without a CAPTCHA or JS-only shell. The one probe covers only the separate register.dpma.de search host, whose robots.txt disallows crawling; that affects the database surface rather than the guidance pages. missing for 10: an explicit hands-on probe of www.dpma.de guidance pages with an identified user agent confirming no bot wall or JS shell, robots.txt status for the main site, and independent corroboration.
